invariants.rationale: Since getName() is stored in a String variable, it must be either null or a String.
getClass() always returns the runtime class of the object and cannot return null.
Class.getName() always returns a non-null String.
image must not be null since image.getDrawable() is called unconditionally in the return statement.
image.getDrawable() is concatenated to a string, indicating that it should not be null.
